source_images: benchmarks/figs/ (publisher-hosted figure exports, preserved for PT re-verification)
provenance_note: Both papers are from the same research group (Moddel et al., University of Colorado Boulder) and describe the same underlying device family (Casimir-cavity MIM photoinjectors); PRR is a companion/follow-up to the Symmetry paper. These are NOT independent replications. All numeric values are approximate figure-reads from publisher-hosted raster images (MDPI PNG exports for Symmetry 13,517; APS 'large' deliverable PNGs for PRR 3,L022007) at native resolutions ~900-1250 px (SYM) and 800 px (PRR) on the long axis. Two PRR anchor values (G at V=0 for 33 nm and 1100 nm, Fig. 3) come from the figure caption text and are essentially exact; all other points are visual/pixel estimates with per-dataset read uncertainty. Unreadable points omitted (see not_extracted). Figure-reads are for ORDER/TREND comparison and pre-registration of expected magnitudes, not precision fitting.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.005 mV in V, +/-5 nA in I (steep curve; slope ~1100-1700 nA/mV makes V-uncertainty dominate); dense marker pitch makes interpolation reliable
datasets.notes: 0.02 um^2 GSM device, 33 nm PMMA cavity. Isc(V=0) ~ 80-83 nA (+/-8). Voc ~ -0.088 mV (+/-0.015). Cross-check: Isc*|Voc|/4 ~ 1.76 pW vs paper's stated 1.4 pW max power — consistent within read uncertainty.
79 nm PMMA cavity. Isc(V=0) ~ 45 nA (+/-4). Voc off-scale left; extrapolated ~ -0.185 to -0.20 mV, +/-0.02 mV (edge-of-plot extrapolation, low confidence).
230 nm PMMA cavity. Isc(V=0) ~ 10 nA (+/-2). Voc ~ -0.10 mV (+/-0.01), crossing visible in range.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.01 mV, +/-1 nA (very flat curve, small signal near marker size)
datasets.notes: 1100 nm PMMA cavity. Isc(V=0) ~ 3 nA (+/-1). Voc does not cross zero in plotted range; extrapolated <~ -0.19 to -0.21 mV, +/-0.03 mV.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-5-8% of value (no error bars on PMMA series in source; marker-center estimate on log axes)
datasets.notes: Cross-checked vs Fig.4(a): 33 nm point (80 nA) matches Isc(V=0) from panel (a).

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.2 log decade (point centers); explicit error bars in figure are much larger, reported in notes
datasets.notes: Error bars (visual, asymmetric on log scale): 40nm [20,65]; 100nm [6,25]; 160nm [1.8,8].

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.3 nm in x, +/-1.5 nA in y (error bars explicit, read in notes)
datasets.notes: Error bars: 8.7nm +/-2.5; 12nm +/-2.5; 18nm +/-5.5; 23.5nm +/-3. Peaks near 12 nm, matching the text claim.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.02 nm in x; +/-0.15 log decade in y
datasets.notes: Large error bars on the two lower-right points (~4-9 nA band); first two points tight.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.3 nA (dense markers, tight scatter band)
datasets.notes: Start ~20.5 nA, mild mid-run rise to ~21.8-22 nA, settles ~20.8 nA at t=4.15 h. Peak-to-peak ~2 nA (~9% of mean). Total duration ~4.15 h.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-3% for the two resolvable points; three small-area points unresolvable (cluster y=0-2 nA), reported as bound only
datasets.notes: Slope ~5.3 pA/um^2 from the two resolvable points; three points at ~25/100/400 um^2 cluster near origin, individually unreadable on the linear axis.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-3-5 nA per curve at given V
datasets.notes: Quantified max-separation read (not digitized series): the three environments (Ambient/Mu-metal/Al box) are NOT within a single line width — max separation ~30 nA (+/-10) near V~2-3 uV (~20-30% of local signal), converging to ~5-10 nA at sweep extremes. Same shape/slope across environments — consistent with the paper's conclusion, but 'statistically identical' is looser than 'within line width'. RELEVANT to our EMI budget row.
Ambient fixed 23.4 degC; stage swept 21.6-24.8 degC. Isc peak-to-peak ~1.5 nA (~3.5% of mean), no trend.
Voc peak-to-peak ~0.3 uV (~2.5% of mean) across the 3.2 degC sweep; flat.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.01 V, +/-0.01 mA (dense marker line, highly linear)
datasets.notes: 33 nm cavity device. Highly linear; slope ~1.0-1.1 mS, consistent with caption anchor G(0V)=1 mS.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.01 V, +/-0.002 mA (very shallow slope, near marker resolution)
datasets.notes: 1100 nm cavity device. Nearly flat; slope ~20 uS, consistent with caption anchor G(0V)=20 uS.

datasets.read_uncertainty: +/-0.1 log decade (~25% of value); source image only 800x344 px
datasets.notes: 33/1100 nm points match the caption anchors (1.05 mS / 0.021 mS read vs 1 mS / 0.02 mS stated) within read uncertainty.

not_extracted: SYM Fig 4(a) 79nm and 1100nm Voc values are extrapolated beyond the plotted voltage range — low-confidence bounds, not direct reads.
SYM Fig 6(b): three small-area points (~25/100/400 um^2) individually unresolvable on the linear axis; cluster bound only.
SYM Fig 10: quantified max-separation estimate only (curves tightly interleaved; per-curve marker assignment unreliable).
PRR Fig 3(b) SiO2 + Fig 4 panels read from 800px APS deliverables — precision ~25% rather than ~5-10%.
